name: Beautiful.ai
summary: AI presentation platform for teams: prompt-to-deck generation and 300+ auto-aligning Smart Slide layouts.
description: Beautiful.ai is an AI presentation platform for individuals and teams. It turns a prompt, outline or source material into a deck, builds slides from 300+ Smart Slide layouts and designer templates that auto-align and animate, keeps everything on-brand with locked themes and shared template libraries, and presents with voice-over and viewer analytics. Pro is $14.50/month billed annually, Team is $40 per user per month, and every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.
contains: AI deck generation from a prompt, outline or files
customizable themes and locked brand controls
